name: Fire Bolt
job: 2d10 fire; ranged damage, +6 to hit
effect: At level 5: 2d10 fire on a hit. An unattended flammable object ignites.
higher: Damage rises at character levels 11 and 17.
caution: A spell attack, not a saving throw.

name: Ray of Frost
job: 2d8 cold; hit reduces target Speed by 10 feet until Kief's next turn
effect: At level 5: 2d8 cold on a hit; reduce Speed by 10 ft until the start of your next turn.
higher: Damage rises at character levels 11 and 17.
caution: Track the speed reduction separately.

name: Mind Sliver
job: Intelligence save; 2d6 psychic and -1d4 on the next save before the end of Kief's next turn
effect: At level 5: on failure, 2d6 psychic and subtract 1d4 from its next saving throw before the end of your next turn.
higher: Damage rises at character levels 11 and 17.
caution: The penalty affects one saving throw; call it out to the party.

name: Light
job: Illumination for teammates without Darkvision; no concentration
target: One object, Large or smaller, not worn or carried by another creature
effect: The object sheds bright light 20 ft and dim light another 20 ft. Choose the color; opaque covering blocks it. Recasting ends the previous light.
caution: Do not apply legacy hostile-creature Dexterity saves to the 2024 version.

name: Prestidigitation
job: Tea temperature, clean clothes, small harmless flourishes
target: Small sensory effects, objects, or material as described
effect: Create a harmless sensation; light or snuff a small flame; clean or soil 1 cubic foot; warm, chill, or flavor 1 cubic foot for 1 hour; mark a surface for 1 hour; or make a palm-sized trinket or image until the end of your next turn. Up to three noninstant effects at once.
caution: Flavor and presentation do not grant damage, healing, or a social success.

name: Minor Illusion
job: Sound or static object image for distractions and explanations
target: A sound or an object image fitting a 5-ft cube
resolution: Study action: Intelligence (Investigation) vs spell DC
effect: Create a sound or stationary object image. The image supplies no sound, light, smell, or other senses. Physical interaction reveals an image; successful examination discerns the illusion. Recasting ends the previous one.
caution: Forest Gnome source: Innate Sorcery does not raise this spell’s DC.

name: Mage Hand
job: Remote handling, within the spell's limits; not an attack or trap detector
resolution: No roll unless the task requires one
effect: Control it on casting and with later Magic actions: move up to 30 ft and manipulate objects, containers, or contents. Carry up to 10 lb. Ends if more than 30 ft away or recast.
caution: Cannot attack, activate magic items, or lift more than 10 lb.

name: Mending
job: Repair small breaks; takes a minute and doesn't restore magical functions
target: One break or tear, at most 1 ft in any dimension
effect: Repair a single break or tear without leaving a trace. It can physically repair a magic item but does not restore its magic.
caution: Too slow for a single combat action; not a healing spell.

name: Shield
job: Stay upright and preserve the control spell already helping everyone
casting: Reaction: hit by an attack roll or targeted by Magic Missile
duration: Until the start of your next turn
effect: Gain +5 AC, including against the triggering attack; take no damage from Magic Missile. Kief’s AC becomes 20.
caution: At AC 15, it turns noncritical totals 15–19 into misses; a total of 20 still hits.

name: Feather Fall
job: Catch up to five falling creatures within 60 feet using a Reaction
casting: Reaction: you or a creature you can see within 60 ft falls
effect: Descent slows to 60 ft per round. Landing before the duration ends causes no falling damage and ends the spell for that creature.
caution: Reserve a Reaction and slot. Subtle Spell can remove these components for 1 SP.

name: Detect Magic
job: Ritual investigation when time permits; detects magic, not every trap
effect: Sense magic nearby. A Magic action reveals an aura on visible magical creatures or objects and a school if an effect is a spell. Blocked by 1 ft of stone, dirt, or wood, 1 inch of metal, or thin lead.
caution: Does not identify creature type, spell name, or every supernatural creature as an active magical effect.

name: Misty Step
job: Bonus Action escape to a visible space within 30 feet; self only
target: You; an unoccupied space you can see within 30 ft
effect: Teleport to the chosen space.
caution: Spending a slot leaves no second spell slot to cast another spell on this turn.

name: Web
job: Restrain enemies and create opportunities for allies' attacks
target: 20-ft cube; anchored between solids or layered 5 ft deep on a surface
resolution: Dexterity save on first entry on a turn or starting a turn there
effect: Webs are difficult terrain and lightly obscure. A failed save Restrains a creature while in the webs or until it breaks free: action, Strength (Athletics) vs spell DC. Unsupported webs collapse at the start of your next turn. A burning 5-ft cube clears in 1 round and deals 2d4 fire to a creature starting its turn in the fire.
caution: No immediate save just because it is cast. Careful Spell’s delayed/repeated-save interaction needs a table ruling; it never removes the terrain.

name: Invisibility
job: Help the party scout or approach quietly
target: One creature and what it wears or carries
components: V, S, M (eyelash in gum arabic)
effect: Target has the Invisible condition. The spell ends for it after it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
higher: One additional target per slot level above 2.
caution: Being invisible does not automatically make you hidden or silent.

name: Counterspell
job: Attempt to interrupt a dangerous enemy spell
casting: Reaction: see a creature within 60 ft casting with V, S, or M components
effect: On failure the spell dissipates with no effect; the casting action, Bonus Action, or Reaction is wasted. If it used a spell slot, that slot is not expended.
higher: No automatic success or level-based scaling.
caution: Use the 2024 save, not the legacy ability check. A cast with no components supplies no trigger.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
job: Remove a group from the immediate fight; use Careful around allies
target: 30-ft cube; creatures in it that see the pattern
effect: On failure: Charmed, Incapacitated, and Speed 0. Ends for a target when it takes damage or another creature uses an action to shake it out.
caution: These creatures are not Unconscious. Careful Spell can protect up to three chosen creatures for 1 SP.

name: Fireball
job: End a dangerous cluster quickly; use Careful around allies
target: 20-ft-radius sphere centered at a point in range
components: V, S, M (bat guano and sulfur)
effect: 8d6 fire, half on success; unattended flammable objects ignite.
higher: Add 1d6 per slot level above 3 (not available at level 5).
caution: Check allies and collateral fire. Careful Spell protects up to three creatures from damage for 1 SP.

name: Chromatic Orb
job: Requires a 50+ GP diamond. Ownership is pending the campaign gear allowance.
target: One creature; possible new targets within 30 ft of the previous target
components: V, S, M (diamond worth at least 50 GP, not consumed)
effect: On a hit: 3d8 acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison, or thunder. If at least two damage dice match, the orb can leap to a different target within 30 ft; make a new attack and damage roll. Each creature can be targeted only once per casting.
higher: Add 1d8 per slot level above 1. Maximum leaps equals the slot level.
caution: Diamond ownership is pending. Subtle Spell does not remove the priced component.

name: Command
job: Interrupt a dangerous foe with a one-word command.
effect: On failure, its next turn follows one command: Approach (shortest route, ends within 5 ft); Drop (drop held items and end turn); Flee (fastest means away); Grovel (Prone, end turn); Halt (no movement, action, or Bonus Action).
higher: One additional target per slot level above 1.
caution: Do not add the old language or Undead restrictions to the 2024 text.

name: Alter Self
job: Adapt your appearance or body to the obstacle.
effect: Choose aquatic adaptation (water breathing; Swim Speed equals Speed), appearance (including voice; same size and basic shape), or natural weapons (Unarmed Strike damage 1d6 plus Charisma, using Charisma to attack). Change mode with a Magic action.
caution: Appearance does not grant another creature’s statistics or skills. Self range cannot be delivered through a familiar.

name: Dragon’s Breath
job: An alternative use of concentration; agree on the plan with the recipient.
effect: Choose acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. The recipient can use a Magic action to exhale a 15-ft cone: 3d6 chosen damage, half on success.
caution: Recipient pays its own action. Familiar use and Careful Spell on later exhalations remain table rulings.

name: Fear
job: Another control option when the situation suits fear.
effect: On failure, drop held items and become Frightened. Each turn, Dash away by the safest route unless there is nowhere to move. End a turn out of your sight: repeat the save, ending the spell on success.
caution: Fleeing may draw Opportunity Attacks or bring reinforcements; agree on pursuit.

name: Fly
job: Help an ally cross an obstacle; agree on a safe landing.
effect: Grant Fly Speed 60 ft and hover. A target aloft when it ends falls unless it can stop the fall.
higher: One additional target per slot level above 3 (not available at level 5).
caution: Agree on landing and preserve your concentration; hold Feather Fall when appropriate.

name: Speak with Animals
job: Three free casts per Long Rest, or slots/ritual. Animals know what animals perceive.
effect: Understand and verbally communicate with Beasts; use Influence skills with them. Their information is shaped by their lives, nearby places, and recent events.
caution: Forest Gnome: three free casts per Long Rest, or slots/ritual. Conversation is not obedience or mind reading.

name: Find Familiar
job: One free cast per Long Rest, or slots/ritual. Still consumes 10+ GP incense; 1 hour, or 70 minutes as a ritual.
target: One familiar spirit in an allowed form
components: V, S, M (burning incense worth at least 10 GP, consumed)
effect: Acts on its own initiative and cannot attack. Within 100 ft: telepathy, Bonus Action shared senses until your next turn, and familiar Reaction to deliver your touch spell. At 0 HP it vanishes; recast to return. A Magic action dismisses it or returns it within 30 ft. Disappearance leaves worn/carried objects behind.
caution: Magic Initiate: one free cast per Long Rest, or slots/ritual; time and incense still apply. Tiny cow appearance and initial summoning are pending. Shared-sense targeting needs the spell’s own requirements.
